name: NGC 4660 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4660, an elliptical galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4660-hubble
story: An elliptical galaxy that also carries a strong disk of stars, NGC 4660 is a member of the Virgo Cluster. Hubble's sharp eye picks out the fuzzy globular star clusters gathered around it.
